title: Dr. Jitendra Singh to confer National Anubhav Awards 2026 at Vigyan Bhawan
subtitle:
Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare to organise 9th National Anubhav Awards Ceremony and 60th Pre-Retirement Counselling Workshop
Handbook on Pension Mitra and Nation-wide DLC Campaign 5 Guidelines to be released
body_text:
The Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare (DoPPW), Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, will organise the 9th National Anubhav Awards Ceremony and the 60th Pre-Retirement Counselling (PRC) Workshop on August 17, 2026, at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi. The events will be held under the auspices of Dr. Jitendra Singh, Minister of State for the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions.
The ‘Anubhav’ platform provides a forum for retiring/retired employees of Central Government employees, 12 Public Sector Banks and Central Public Sector Enterprises to share their experiences of working in the Government.
For the National Anubhav Awards Scheme, 2026, the 15 selected awardees have contributed to the Nation-building and have been part of various ambitious projects of Government of India viz., Passport Seva Kendra, repealing of old rules and formulation of new rules, suiting the current scenario, Technological adaptation in the administration and accounting, Energy conservation etc.
Dr. Jitendra Singh will confer the National Anubhav Awards, 2026 to them at the 9th National Anubhav Awards Ceremony.
The 60th Pre-Retirement Counselling Workshop is being organised for retiring employees of the Government of India, primarily posted in the National Capital Region (NCR) to know about the information on the processes required for timely payment of retirement benefits.
The event will also feature the release of the Handbook on Pension Mitra, and Guidelines for the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign 5.
A Bank Exhibition will also be organised as part of the programme, where 17 Pension Disbursing Banks will showcase their products and services designed for the retiring employees.

enrichment.summary: The Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare will hold the 9th National Anubhav Awards Ceremony and 60th Pre-Retirement Counselling Workshop on 17 August 2026 at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi, under Dr. Jitendra Singh. Fifteen awardees will be honoured for contributions to initiatives like Passport Seva Kendra and administrative technological adaptation, and a Handbook on Pension Mitra along with Guidelines for Digital Life Certificate Campaign 5 will be released.
enrichment.context: The Anubhav portal and National Anubhav Awards Scheme are ongoing initiatives of DoPPW to document institutional knowledge and best practices from retiring government employees, PSU bank staff, and CPSE employees. Pre-Retirement Counselling Workshops and Digital Life Certificate (DLC) campaigns are part of the government's broader pension welfare and ease-of-living reforms for retirees, using technology like Jeevan Pramaan for life certificate submission to reduce hassles for pensioners, especially the elderly. These are recurring administrative events rather than new policy announcements.
